sentences.japanese: みんなが彼の描く絵を誉めているね。
sentences.english: Everyone admires the pictures painted by him.

sentences.japanese: なぜアメリカ人の両親は自分の子供を誉めるのか。
sentences.english: Why do American parents praise their children?

sentences.japanese: その少年を誉めない人はひとりもいなかった。
sentences.english: There was no one that did not admire the boy.

sentences.japanese: シルビアは誉めてくれる事のない厳格な父親を持っていた。
sentences.english: Silvia had a stern father who never praised her.

sentences.japanese: 立派な仕事をしたと彼を誉めた。
sentences.english: We commended him for his good work.
